A '''water orb''' is a glass orb that has been charged at the [[Obelisk of Water]] by using the [[Charge Water Orb]] spell, requiring 56 [[Magic]], on the obelisk. The spell requires an [[unpowered orb]], 30 [[water rune]]s, and 3 [[cosmic rune]]s, yielding 66 Magic [[experience]]. 

The Water Obelisk is located on the island across from the shore of [[Catherby]], getting there by climbing a ladder at the end of [[Taverley Dungeon]] by the [[black dragon]]s. Accessing this section of the dungeon requires the [[dusty key]] or 70 agility.

A water orb can be used on a [[battlestaff]], requiring 54 [[Crafting]], yielding a [[water battlestaff]] and 100 Crafting experience.
